drhp.business: SpiceJet is a low-cost passenger airline based in India. It operates a fleet that includes Boeing 737 NG, Boeing 737 MAX and Bombardier Q400 aircraft, using a mix of owned and leased aircraft including wet-leased (damp-leased) capacity. As of mid-2025 it operated about 147 daily flights across 38 domestic destinations and 3 international destinations. Besides scheduled services it operates charter flights and Haj flights, having received a Government of India mandate for Haj operations from Srinagar, Guwahati, Gaya and Kolkata. In October 2025 it inducted additional leased Boeing 737 aircraft and returned previously grounded Boeing 737 MAX aircraft to service.
